title: Learn the article with the noun
summary: A sample note on treating German nouns and their articles as a pair.

content.text: Example lesson: German nouns have grammatical gender, and nouns are capitalized. Learning a noun with its definite article helps build useful associations.
These are nominative singular forms. Articles can change with grammatical case; this short example is a starting point rather than a complete rule for every sentence.
Try it: make three vocabulary cards with the article on the same side as the noun.

source.label: Demonstration lesson · not a personal learning record
